items.reason: Pinning needs the network: `npm run actions:pin` resolves each tag through the GitHub API and, in the same pass, writes STRICT = true and RATCHET.pinned back into scripts/actions-pin.mjs — an offline session cannot invent a real digest, and Dependabot already covers the github-actions ecosystem, so nothing else is missing.

scripts/gate-timings.mjs runs the check:ci chain (parsed from the same package.json entry) with a clock on each stage, records every duration, publishes the per-stage table plus each stage's share into the CI job summary and a 90-day artifact, and fails when the measurement contradicts the cheapest-first order or a "seconds" label; ci.yml now invokes it instead of the untimed chain.

scripts/harness-degradation.mjs declares every key-gated capability, agent-review.yml now announces on BOTH sides of its keyless branch (::warning annotation + job summary + a harness-status.json artifact kept 90 days), `--drill` removes each key on purpose and asserts all three signals appear (blocking via test-unit/harness-degradation.test.mjs inside check:ci, and published weekly with the live key state into the review's trail issue), and `--check` fails on any workflow reaching for a secrets.* name no capability declares.

A mutation score cannot be produced without executing the suite, and this session has no test runner: any floor I wrote would be a guessed number in a blocking gate. The decision it needs from a human is also a real one — ADR-0008 keeps repo tooling on Node built-ins, so Stryker would be a new dev dependency needing an `Ack:`, versus a repo-local mutator over src/lib/llm/ and the store seam.

The artefact this asks for is a REHEARSED rollback with its timing and outcome, which needs the deployed Vercel project, the provider tokens and a `git push` — all three are red in AGENTS.md § What you may do unattended and none of them exist in this session; a runbook written without running it is the documentation the item explicitly does not count.

lessons: This repository already has the mechanism for almost everything an Ascent gap names — the gap is usually that the mechanism rests on a hand-written claim (a `cost: "seconds"` label, a step that is skipped rather than announced) that nothing ever measures. Look for the unmeasured claim before adding a tool.

Adding a stage to `npm run check:ci` here is expensive: gate-remedy.mjs's CHAIN, its unit test, the prose counts in AGENTS.md/ci.yml and docs/parity.json all encode the chain. A new invariant is cheaper and just as blocking when it enters through `test:unit`, which is already in the chain.

A `continue-on-error: true` step inside a job named in .github/required-checks.json must also be listed in that entry's `softenedSteps`, or `npm run merge-gate` fails the build — evidence-keeping steps (artifact uploads) are the usual reason to add one.
